name: My Hentai Fantasy
source:
You just wake up without remembering anything, apparently, you're living a dream life, but why does everything seem so odd?

You are about to go to university and your father is one of the richest men alive, but the fact that you don't remember anything after waking up makes you very uneasy, so you try to find answers.

But who knows, maybe the answers you're looking for are not worth it... Or are they? I guess it's better if you find out for yourself.

Enjoy a story-rich visual novel with mini-games and an open world where you can go after your favorite waifu.

[From [url=https://naughty-capy.itch.io/my-hentai-fantasy]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你突然醒来，什么都不记得了，显然，你过着梦想的生活，但为什么一切看起来那么奇怪？

你即将上大学，你的父亲是世界上最富有的人之一，但你醒来后什么都不记得了，这让你很不安，所以你试图寻找答案。

但谁知道呢，也许你正在寻找的答案并不值得……或者值得吗？我想如果你自己去发现的话会更好。

享受故事丰富的视觉小说，配有迷你游戏和开放世界，你可以在其中追逐你最喜欢的外婆。

[来自[url=https://naughty-capy.itch.io/my-hentai-fantasy]Itch.io[/url]]
